measurement_definitions: end_to_end_client_rtt: time from client request transmit to final byte received by client; requires client-side SDK timestamps
server_processing: time from server receive (post-auth) to server send (final token batch); captured in Redwood control plane
streaming_chunk_latency: time from server send of first token chunk to client receipt of that chunk; measured per-chunk distribution
token_generation_latency: per-token generation time on GPU (useful for kernel selection only), not exposed in SLA
aggregation_windows: rolling 1h for alerting, 30d for SLA compliance calculation, with p50/p95/p99 computed over request-level latencies
po\u0441_results_summary: Non-streaming (chat) baseline: p50 60ms, p95 240ms, p99 420ms under targeted concurrency (200 rps).
Streaming baseline: perceived p50 35ms p95 140ms p99 380ms measured on chunk receipts; end-to-end client RTTs were ~10-15ms higher on average.
Throughput observed: sustained 180 rps with reserved 2x A100p8 equivalent; headroom to 260 rps before queueing appears.
Cache effect: prefix KV caching reduced p95 by ~30% for repeat flows; cold-starts explain most p99 spikes.
slo_proposal: Dual SLO model: server_processing SLO + end_to_end SLO. Server SLO targets: p95 < 250ms, p99 < 450ms. End-to-end targets: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 520ms.
Streaming SLO adjustments: measure chunk-first-byte p95 < 160ms (client RTT allowance included).
Exclusions: scheduled maintenance windows, client's network outages (measured via client heartbeats), and cold model load spikes during first 15 minutes of deploys.
Remediation: service credits on 30d SLA window if p99 breaches exceed 2 incidents per quarter; detailed incident reporting required.
negotiation_points: Define canonical measurement source: Redwood control plane timestamps vs client SDK timestamps — client insists on SDK-based end-to-end metric.
Cold-start exclusion period duration — client wants 10 minutes, Redwood proposes 5 minutes with warmup steps.
Penalty structure: credits capped at 12% of monthly bill vs client requested 20%; propose middle ground (15%) with escalation clauses.
Throughput guarantees: baseline reserved capacity with autoscale burst to public capacity subject to cost-sharing model — need legal signoff.
